tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ldan tshogs gnyis ma bzhugs so/ /

dpa' ldan tshogs gnyis rin chen gzhal med khang*/ /dge legs bye ba'i gzi 'od mchog tu 'bar/ /thugs rje'i rta bdun srid zhi'i mun sel ba// tshe dpag med mgon nyin byed la phyag 'tshal/ /tshad med 'gro la thugs rje'i gzhan dbang gis/ /dpag med rnam dkar 'phrin las 'od stong 'gyed// grangs med skye rgu'i skyon gyi mun pa sel/ /mgon med kun gyi skyabs mchog la phyag 'tshal/ /padma rā ga'i sa 'dzin dbang po ni/ /mtshan dpe'i dpal gyis lhag par brjid pa'i sku/ /rdo rje'i dkyil krung ting 'dzin phyag rgya can// yid 'phrog lta bas mi ngoms la phyag 'tshal/ /mthon mthing ral pa'i chu 'dzin spyi bor bcings/ /rab mdzes nam bza'i chu khur ci yang g.yo/ /rin chen bye ba'i glog 'phreng 'od stong 'gyed/ /tshangs dbyangs 'brug staung sgrog la phyag 'tshal lo| |zhi ba'i nyams ldan nad gdon bar chad sel/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro la thugs rje lhag par gzigs/ /'dzum ldan tshe dang dpal 'byor ye shes rgyas// mtha' dag dbang du mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyad par tshe ring don gnyer sngon las kyis/ /dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pas nyen pa yi/ /gang gi mtshan tsam dran pas skad cig la/ /'jigs chen myur du skyobs mdzad la phyag 'tshal// mdor na tshe dang bsod nams ye shes kyi// rgyu tshogs nye bar stsol bar gtso mdzad pa/ /skyabs su brtain pa kun la dpal 'byor tshe/ /ye shes bde blag stsaul der bdag phyag 'tshal/ /'gro 'dis rnyed ka'i mtho ris thob srid kyang*// tshe mthar son pa rgya lam tsam du zad/ /bdag cag dus min 'chi bas 'jigs rnams kyi/ /skyabs mgon bla na med khyod la phyag 'tshal/ khyod kyi zhabs pad legs par brten pa dag /gnas skabs tshe ring dpal 'byor blo 'chog 'phel| |mthar thug srid zhi'i rgud pa kun bcom nas/ /tshe dpag med mgon myur du thob par shog /tshe rabs kun tu rnam 'dren khyod nyid kyis/ /rjes su bzung shing dge tshogs ma lus pa/

/gegs med thob nas 'gro 'd-i srid mtsho las| |myur du sgrol ba'i sde dpon bgyid par shog /dge ba 'dis kyang ma rgan 'gro ba la/ /phan bde stsol ba'i sbyin bdag thub bstan 'dir/ /mi phyed mthun pa'i bstan 'dzin gyis brgyan te/ /phyogs dus bshad sgrub dpal gyis khyab gyur cig /ces pa stag tshang lo tsā ba/ shes rab rin chen gyis sbyar ba'o//// madga laṃ// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/dpal ldan tshogs gnyis ma/ PAGE 174-- -PAGE 173-- PAGE 173-
